_comment: Public crypto REFERENCE constants for wallet extraction (WebPivot/tools/wp_crypto_refs.py → wp_extract.valid_crypto_address / extract_token_contracts, tools/pivot_routes.wallet_rung, quarry_bridge). Ported from Quarry data/crypto-reference-addresses.yaml. Matching: 0x… and bech32 (bc1/ltc1/tb1) compare case-insensitively, base58 exactly. RULE 1: publicly documented spec/doc/protocol constants only — NEVER case data, NEVER an address discovered in an investigation.

reference_crypto_addresses._comment: Documentation / BIP-EIP test vectors, genesis, burn and system-program addresses. A match is DROPPED outright — never a wallet indicator, never ingested, never balance-looked-up. Value = provenance note.

entries.1A1zP1eP5QGefi2DMPTfTL5SLmv7DivfNa: Satoshi Nakamoto genesis coinbase reward address
entries.0xd8dA6BF26964aF9D7eEd9e03E53415D37aA960: Vitalik Buterin's public Ethereum address (widely cited)
entries.11111111111111111111111111111111: Solana System Program address (all ones in base58)

token_contracts._comment: Well-known token / stablecoin CONTRACT addresses. A match is a fixed public constant on every site that accepts the token, not a payee: it never becomes an operator wallet, never edges or clusters two domains, and never triggers crypto_balance. It is kept only as a non-attributive payment-method fact (rung class wallet.token_contract → kit). chain uses the extractor's coin labels (eth, tron). Base58 is case-sensitive and an entry must pass the extractor's checksum to ever match: Quarry's source list spells USDT-TRC20 'KQXGTC' (fails base58check, so it would never match); the checksum-valid published contract 'KQxGTC' is used here.
